acceptance_fixed.diagnostic_ci95: Retain CI95 coverage and exact CP95; separately flag definite undercoverage if CP95 upper <0.95. Operational99% interval is a new, named, stricter interval, never evidence that nominal95% has calibrated.
acceptance_fixed.failure_rule: FWER CP95 lower>0.05 or operational CI99 coverage CP95 upper<0.95 is failure; any confidence-bound criterion not established is inconclusive. Retain all results. No tolerance widening.
acceptance_fixed.operational_ci99_coverage_demonstrated_i: CP95 lower >=0.95 for CI99 MSE difference AND CI99 relative aggregate RMSE gain
acceptance_fixed.overall_claim: At most conditional scope admission for these five DGPs/T/K/L and CI99 procedure if ALL prescribed bounds pass; never general finite market validation, actual-data sizing or R3 accreditation.
acceptance_fixed.power_target_demonstrated_only_if: CP95 lower >=0.90 for EVERY rival complete gate under the prespecified strong alternative; jointpower reported; no power claim for 3% alternative

benchmark_before_plan: Deterministic sinusoidal fixture only, no new DGP outcomes: native B8191/T768/m20/lag48 bootstrap0.577 CPU seconds, numpy2.958 seconds before index-slab improvement. Predict roughly600CPU seconds for960 replicates plus fixed reference and reporting;900CPU ceiling.
budget_rule: Stop between complete replicates if elapsed CPU reaches 300 seconds; retain all results and label unfinished scenarios incomplete; never reduce uncertainty or silently drop failed replicates.
coverage: Report real CI95 and CI99 separately. Operational interval is explicitly CI99, studentized stationary bootstrap (log-MSE-ratio delta studentization for gain). Validate its actual coverage against >=0.95 with exact CP95 lower bound; never relabel it CI95 or hide diagnostic CI95 failures. Prespecified rival0, each scenario.
data_generator: Stationary bounded AR innovations after burn-in 300; common and idiosyncratic cross-rival differences; moving average for overlap scenario; exogenous lagged AR instrument independent of loss differences; losses positive, square roots used as predictions against y=0; fixed seed offsets cancel in differences. Strong alternative is deliberately large and does not establish power at 3% gain.
family: 120 absolute-tail two-sided p-values (count+1)/(reps+1): 20 rivals x 3 methods x EPA/practical; Holm across all120. Every method exposes MC count/reps/rule. Shared fixed-b reference draw seed independent of temporal synthetic datasets.
fwer_event: Any adjusted p<0.05 among the exact null contrasts and the three methods, either direction. Practical tests at a nonzero mean are not counted as equality-null violations. Also report false positive directional superiority.
gate: All6 adjustedp<.05, positive EPA and practical means, historical meanRMSE favorable, effect>=0.2, CI95MSElower>0 AND CI99MSElower>0 AND CI99gainlower>margin; all20 rivals forjoint gate.
implementation_identity: Source hashes for statistics.py, native C++ kernel, runner, tests and this plan must be frozen before simulation. Native is exact arithmetic acceleration of numpy algorithm; no RNG/decisions in native kernel.
power: Per-rival complete statistical gate and joint all-20 gate; report worst per-rival power with CP95 interval; target 0.90; only large simulated alternative covered
purpose: Substantive V3 repair of failed V1/V2: fixed-b Gaussian scalar/vector reference instead of t/chi-square; stationary bootstrap-t with replicate HAC; operational CI99 explicitly stronger than retained diagnostic CI95. No market claims.
revision_reason: Finite-HAC sampling variability was omitted by t/chi-square references, and unstudentized centered bootstrap/basic CIs did not cover. Kiefer-Vogelsang2005 Theorem3 motivates scalar/vector fixed-b calibration under FCLT. This changes procedure, not acceptance thresholds.
